classification.difficultyReason: Recognise that actual dimensions must be reduced for the plan, convert metres to centimetres and divide by the scale denominator.

content.prompt: A plan of a house is drawn to a scale of $1:200$. Find the measurement on the plan of:

children.label: a
children.prompt: the hall, which has length $6\text{ m}$

answer.worked:
$6\text{ m}=600\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Plan length}&=600\div200\text{ cm}\\\text{Plan length}&=3\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: the bedroom, which has width $3\text{ m}$

answer.worked:
$3\text{ m}=300\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Plan width}&=300\div200\text{ cm}\\\text{Plan width}&=1.5\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

children.label: c
children.prompt: the walls, which have height $2.8\text{ m}$

answer.worked:
$2.8\text{ m}=280\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Plan height}&=280\div200\text{ cm}\\\text{Plan height}&=1.4\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

children.label: d
children.prompt: the side of the house, which has length $11.2\text{ m}$

answer.worked:
$11.2\text{ m}=1120\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Plan length}&=1120\div200\text{ cm}\\\text{Plan length}&=5.6\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$

children.label: e
children.prompt: the kitchen table, which has width $1.2\text{ m}$

answer.worked:
$1.2\text{ m}=120\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Plan width}&=120\div200\text{ cm}\\\text{Plan width}&=0.6\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
